messages:
Sam: Heads-up — FinServX submitted a request via support: they want per-team cost labels that flow through console billing, traces, and dashboard exports. They need to show cost by business unit and tie spikes to traces. Customer wants an ETA within Q2.
Maya: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the customer's exact ask and priority? Do they need historical backfill or just going forward?
Sam: Copying the customer's note: "We need team tags on every inference request so we can map usage to teams. Would like billable dashboards and an ability to click from a cost spike to related traces. Prefer a turnkey console flow." They flagged as high priority because procurement requires visibility. No explicit backfill ask.
Devin: From sales — FinServX is evaluating Dedicated. If we can offer this as part of the Dedicated onboarding (maybe as an add-on) they are likely to commit. They asked about pricing for per-tenant reports.
Maya: Sounds like two buckets: 1) tag propagation + export (billing) 2) trace linking UX. We should define an MVP. Proposal: a) accept a new `team` label on requests, b) surface a per-team cost slice in Console -> Usage, c) add a trace link in the cost drilldown to Jump to Trace view. Anything else?
Aria: Technical constraints: we already store some request metadata in our telemetry pipeline, but not consistently at token level. Propagating `team` tag is straightforward for Hosted; Dedicated/private will need config and potentially a header we respect. Trace linking requires trace IDs to be included in billing events or a link between our metrics pipeline and traces — need to add `trace_id` to sampled billing events.
Keegan: Observability notes: we can add `team` to metrics and roll to per-route dashboards. For trace jump, we need deterministic sample keys. Two options: include `trace_id` in the cost event (cheaper) or store a short mapping (event_id -> trace_id) in a lookup index (more resilient). Suggest start with including `trace_id` when available, fallback to a sampled index later.
Maya: Launch criteria (proposal): 1) Console shows per-team cost for last 30/90 days, 2) Users can filter by `team`, 3) Cost drilldown shows a `Jump to Trace` button when `trace_id` exists, 4) Docs + UI flag for Dedicated config.
Sam: Customer is okay with an initial forward-only solution. They asked for export CSV with `team`,`date`,`tokens`,`cost` as immediate deliverable.
Devin: OK to bundle CSV export with the early access. FinServX will sign NDA for a pilot. This increases priority.
Aria: Rough effort estimates: tagging + pipeline changes ~2w, Console slice + CSV export ~1w, trace_id plumbing + drilldown ~2w. Total MVP ~5 engineer-weeks, plus QA and docs.
Maya: Risks: data volume for long retention, Dedicated config UX, and edge cases where requests lack team context. We should define fallback behavior ("unknown").
Keegan: Ops note: add telemetry gating flag so we can rollout gradually to a subset of customers. Also add a sampling policy for trace_id inclusion to avoid log blowup.
Maya: Actions: 1) @Sam confirm pilot NDA and get contact for Dedicated config, 2) @Aria write a short tech spec with required event fields (`team`, `trace_id`, `route_id`, `tokens`), 3) @Keegan draft rollout gating + sampling plan, 4) @Devin capture commercial ask and pricing proposal. I'll schedule a scoping sync next Tue. :calendar:
OpsBot: Ticket created: PROD-4721 — "Per-team cost labels + trace linking (FinServX pilot)" <https://tracker/internal/PROD-4721> :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll send the customer's contact and sample payloads. Example they sent: `{\n  "request_id": "abc123",\n  "team": "payments",\n  "trace_id": "1-5759ef5f-3d4b6e2c...",\n  "tokens": 120\n}`
Devin: 👍 add a note to the pilot docs that we may offer backfill as a paid service later.
Maya: Great. Keeping scope to forward-only for MVP. We'll firm estimates after spec. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
